findings.claim: The spaceId parameter is unused (omitted) in every implementation, so its presence in the interface is unjustified.
A test case for the unauthenticated scenario (expecting a 403 when no access token is provided) is missing and should be added.
Test database creation and teardown are done manually with raw admin queries instead of using the existing TestDbFactory helper, which would simplify the code.
This test also manually creates/destroys the test database instead of using the TestDbFactory helper.

The current conditional logic could be implemented as a switch/case instead, which would provide a compile-time exhaustiveness check and prevent a differing type from silently falling through unhandled.
This function appears to duplicate functionality already provided by the existing materializedSubscriptionBuilder, raising the question of why a separate function is needed.
